models._comment: DISABLED. History: sherpa-onnx was briefly bumped to 1.13.4 to try parakeet-tdt-v3, but 1.13.4 bundles a prebuilt onnxruntime 1.23.2 whose autoEP DeviceDiscovery::DiscoverDevicesForPlatform() aborts with 'free(): invalid pointer' during Ort CreateEnv (ABI mismatch in the statically-linked prebuilt ORT) — that runs before any model loads, so it crashed EVERY sherpa recognizer (parakeet, Zipformer, AND SenseVoice), verified via the C API on both build container and prod node. The port was therefore REVERTED to 1.10.39 (bundles ORT 1.17.1, no DeviceDiscovery); SenseVoice and Zipformer transducers work again on it. parakeet-tdt-v3 stays disabled because its TDT model format needs a sherpa newer than 1.10.39, and the newer sherpa is unusable until upstream ships an ORT without the CreateEnv crash. Working sherpa STT: SenseVoice (below) + Zipformer transducers. Whisper models use whisper.cpp (no onnxruntime) and were never affected.
